card.name: Section numbers before a dot subsection
card.fires_on: A section number such as 5 or 7 right before '.1' in drug-label headings, where a numbered subsection follows. It also fires on a colon introducing a lettered sub-list.

modes.label: Section number before .1
modes.description: The top-level section number at the start of a numbered subsection heading in a label.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS <<5>>.1 Transmissible infectious agents Because RE

modes.label: Cross-reference list end
modes.description: The last number in a parenthetical list of section references, followed by .1 and a subsection title.

card.writes: It promotes subsection-like tokens, suggesting the model expects a subsection numbering or sub-list to follow.
card.plain: It marks a section number that is about to be followed by a subsection number like .1.
